description: Keeps a voice from ElevenLabs' library (voice_library_search's ownerId and voiceId) for the project, under the name given, so it can be picked by name in Create. It uses none of the plan's voices of its own and spends nothing.

name.description: What the owner will pick it by; its library name when left out.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

name: voice_keep
title: Keep a library voice
